critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the fuselage geometry by adding two distinct horizontal window rows along the cylindrical body. Set the primary row at a 15-degree upward tilt from the centerline and the secondary row above it. Instead of uniform dots, use a repeating array of rectangular primitives with a 2:1 width-to-height ratio. Introduce 30% larger gaps in this array to accommodate four main cabin door outlines (recessed rectangles) spaced evenly along the fuselage length.

discrepancies.observed: A single continuous line of small dots along the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: Multiple distinct rows of windows (main deck and upper deck).

discrepancies.observed: No visible window structure on the forward hump area.
discrepancies.reference: A distinct row of windows following the curve of the upper deck.

discrepancies.observed: Smooth fuselage surface with no breaks or recessed lines for doors.
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular outlines and seams for main cabin doors.

discrepancies.observed: Uniformly spaced dots across the entire length of the cylinder.
discrepancies.reference: Varied spacing with larger gaps around door locations and cockpit area.
